caption: The drawing depicts a tall, wooden grandfather clock with a rich reddish-brown color, showcasing a natural wood grain pattern throughout its body. The clock is rectangular with a broader base, tapering slightly towards the top section, and is ornamented with decorative moldings and panels on the front. The lower section consists of a rectangular base with beveled corners and raised panels, followed by a narrow middle section featuring a central long door with a glass or inset panel to reveal the wood grain. At the top is an ornate hood with a swan’s neck pediment, crowned by three finials (one central, two on the sides), and flanked by pairs of small columns. The clock face is white, circular, and marked with Roman numerals, delicate black hands, and black decorative text at the center. Above the face is an arched section accented with painted floral decorations in shades of pink, purple, and green. On the upper left of the drawing, there is an inset pencil sketch of a partial side profile of the clock, annotated with a scale at the bottom, but without added color. The artist's name, Francis Law Durand, appears at the bottom right corner of the page.
title: Grandfather's Clock (Timepiece)
